basis: Sale consideration by share swap (COLLECTION.md s1, Point Nine 2026-09-26): Invesdor Oy bought 100% of Speedinvest-backed Finnest (Vienna) in July 2019, and the firm's Invesdor card carries Finnest's 2014 invest year and describes the combined group. The investment is Finnest, which reads acquired (decisions.md D5).

Merger successor of the ShopUp position: SILQ Group was formed in April 2025 by merging ShopUp (Dhaka) with Sary (Riyadh) (MENAbytes, 2025-04-09); the firm's card says so. Keeping both rows would count one investment twice (s3 identity_conflated); the member is ShopUp (decisions.md D5).

Merger successor of the TIER position: TIER merged with Dott in January 2024 (the firm's own TIER card: 'merged with Dott in January 2024'); Speedinvest never invested in Dott directly and the board lists the combined company under its new name. One investment, counted once under TIER (decisions.md D5).
